name: 李宜庭
objective:
1. 熱力學精簡複習 2. 有機朗肯循環的介紹 3. 有機朗肯循環與蒸汽朗肯循環的差異 4. 工作流體的選擇與系統效率 5. 熱源與熱沉 6. 系統元件的設計 7. 有機朗肯循環的應用 8. 系統最佳化探討 9. 為落後地區人們所設計的有機朗肯循環 10. 與全球暖化、碳稅等議題有關之議題探討
1. Brief review of Thermodynamics 2. Introduction of ORC 3. Difference from steam Rankine cycle 4. Selection in working fluid & System efficiency 5. Heat source and heat sink 6. System components design 7. ORC application 8. System optimization 9. ORC for undeveloped territories 10. Related to the issues of global warming, carbon tax, etc.
